title: Fox and Box Accumulation
statementMd:
Fox Ciel has $*n*$ boxes in her room. They have the same size and weight, but they might have different strength. The $*i*$-th box can hold at most $*x*_{*i*}$ boxes on its top (we'll call $*x*_{*i*}$ the strength of the box).

Since all the boxes have the same size, Ciel cannot put more than one box directly on the top of some box. For example, imagine Ciel has three boxes: the first has strength 2, the second has strength 1 and the third has strength 1. She cannot put the second and the third box simultaneously directly on the top of the first one. But she can put the second box directly on the top of the first one, and then the third box directly on the top of the second one. We will call such a construction of boxes a *pile*.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d5cf6063f19720478b7c5ce6a333316efcb77466.png)

Fox Ciel wants to construct piles from all the boxes. Each pile will contain some boxes from top to bottom, and there cannot be more than $*x*_{*i*}$ boxes on the top of $*i*$-th box. What is the minimal number of piles she needs to construct?

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$). The next line contains $*n*$ integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 100$).

## Output

Output a single integer — the minimal possible number of piles.

## Note

In example 1, one optimal way is to build 2 piles: the first pile contains boxes 1 and 3 (from top to bottom), the second pile contains only box 2.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95953987c212bd9ce53b34a2747380aede0b1367.png)

In example 2, we can build only 1 pile that contains boxes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (from top to bottom).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2134478fada57938dd43bc14b6c91b3449d2d4fd.png)
statementZhMd:
Fox Ciel 的房间里有 $*n*$ 个箱子。它们的大小和重量都相同，但坚固程度可能不同。第 $*i*$ 个箱子最多可以承受放在其顶部的 $*x*_{*i*}$ 个箱子（我们称 $*x*_{*i*}$ 为该箱子的强度）。

由于所有箱子的大小都相同，Ciel 不能将多个箱子直接放在同一个箱子的顶部。例如，假设 Ciel 有三个箱子：第一个箱子的强度为 2，第二个箱子的强度为 1，第三个箱子的强度也为 1。她不能同时将第二个和第三个箱子直接放在第一个箱子的顶部。但她可以先将第二个箱子直接放在第一个箱子的顶部，再将第三个箱子直接放在第二个箱子的顶部。我们将这样的箱子构造称为一个*箱子堆*。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d5cf6063f19720478b7c5ce6a333316efcb77466.png)

Fox Ciel 想要用所有箱子构造若干个箱子堆。每个箱子堆从上到下包含一些箱子，并且第 $*i*$ 个箱子的顶部不能放置超过 $*x*_{*i*}$ 个箱子。她至少需要构造多少个箱子堆？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——所需箱子堆数量的最小值。

## 说明

在样例 1 中，一种最优方案是构造 2 个箱子堆：第一个箱子堆从上到下包含箱子 1 和 3，第二个箱子堆只包含箱子 2。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/95953987c212bd9ce53b34a2747380aede0b1367.png)

在样例 2 中，我们只需构造 1 个箱子堆，该箱子堆从上到下包含箱子 1、2、3、4、5。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2134478fada57938dd43bc14b6c91b3449d2d4fd.png)
